Nuggets @ Rockets 7/10 7:30 - Jokic probable, should be close
Spurs @ Suns 4/10 8:00 - Wemby against thin Suns, likely comfortable
Lakers @ Hawks 6/10 6:00 - Reaves questionable, back-to-back Lakers

games.notes: Capela and Adams out for Houston; Jokic, Murray probable. Contender hosting a banged-up-but-dangerous Denver, should be close and worth your night.
Reaves questionable, Grimes out for LA, which is on a back-to-back; Hawks missing Newell and Gilbert. Lakers still lean, but should be a tight one.
Barnes, Quickley and Murray-Boyles all questionable for Toronto, Kawhi out; Stewart and Pippen out for Memphis. Two young fun teams, should be close.
Vassell and Harris out for San Antonio, Goodwin questionable for Phoenix. Wembanyama and the Spurs should handle a thin Suns team, likely comfortable.
Anthony Davis and Coulibaly questionable for Washington; Duren out for Detroit, which is on a back-to-back. Cade's Pistons favored but a sneaky watch if Davis plays.
Haliburton out for Indiana, Lively out for Dallas. Flagg's Mavs on a back-to-back, but still a mid team limping in; likely Dallas.
Trey Murphy out for New Orleans; Butler and Porzingis out for Golden State. Curry is the only reason to tune in, likely a Warriors win.
Knueppel, Miller, Schroder out for Charlotte; Allen questionable for Cleveland. Mid team against a gutted tanker, skip.
